briefs.episode_title: There Is No Silver Shortage: What Investors Keep Getting It Wrong
briefs.one_line_summary: Analysis suggests perceptions of a silver shortage are inaccurate when excluding investment demand.
core_claims: Comex silver inventories are historically large.
Silver demand is stronger in North America than Europe due to tariff concerns.
